bio.text: Al Taylor has represented New York's 71st Assembly District, covering Harlem, Washington Heights and Inwood, since 2017, when he won a special election.
Before the Assembly he was chief of staff to Assemblyman Herman "Denny" Farrell Jr. and a district leader, and in 2008 he founded the Man Up! in Harlem program.

He is the pastor of Infinity Mennonite Church in Harlem and holds a Doctorate of Ministry from Northeastern Seminary, a Master of Divinity from Nyack College Alliance Theological Seminary and a B.A. from Lehman College.
